values.note: RV/trailer sites with electric and water $30; primitive RV/trailer sites $20; tent sites $15; stalls $20, corrals $15. $2 booking fee per reservation, $2 per pet. Deposit of one night; holidays paid in full within 7 days of arrival. 'Reservation system prices are always current.'

fees.source: https://www.rockbottomhorsecamp.com/pricing ('RV/Trailers sites w/electric & water - $30', 'RV/Trailers primitive sites - $20', 'Tent sites - $15') + https://www.rockbottomhorsecamp.com/policies ('Each reservation will be charged a $2 Booking Fee'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.rockbottomhorsecamp.com/ ('All sites have water and 50/30/20 amp electrical connections'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 8 horse-trailer/RV sites: one 70 ft (site 1), four 60 ft, three 50 ft; separate tent sites between two creeks; a rental travel trailer.

sites.source: https://www.rockbottomhorsecamp.com/ ('Our campground has 8 sites for your horse trailer or RV', '1 - 70' site ... 4 - 60' sites ... 3 - 50' sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book online (ResNexus), by phone 276-445-6676 or reservations@rockbottomhorsecamp.com. One night's deposit; cancellations more than 14 days out refunded less $10. Check-in 2 pm (tell them if arriving after 8 pm), check-out noon. Horses need a current negative Coggins.

booking.source: https://www.rockbottomhorsecamp.com/pricing ('Book online, call us at 276-445-6676 or email', 'Check-In is at 2 pm', 'Check-Out is 12 pm') + https://www.rockbottomhorsecamp.com/policies (deposit and cancellation) + 'Book Online' link on https://www.rockbottomhorsecamp.com/, read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: $30 electric/water RV site ($2 booking fee added), 8 sites to 70 ft, 50-amp with water, reservable online (ResNexus). Not horse-only: the home page says 'A Campground for Equestrian Campers / RV & Tent Campers Too!' and the policies page 'All Campers Welcome'. Not stated on the operator pages: showers/wifi/dump, season.
